item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-23
item.description:
1. [Tech News] You won’t see a Galaxy Watch 10 until 2028 – here’s why
In an effort to cut costs, Samsung is postponing the launch of the Galaxy Watch 10, according to reports. Here’s what to know.

2. [Tech News] Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.

3. [Tech News] Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.

4. [Tech News] How Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO
Three significant backers share what gave them conviction to bet billions on Anthropic.
